checkAutoEarlyStop.description:
Criteria to early stop hpo search and retrieve a {@link Hpo.ExperimentBase} based on a targetScore if
set to true.

targetScore.description:
targetScore to early stop hpo search in {@link Hpo.ExperimentBase}. The validation score in {@link Hpo.Trial}
needs to be greater than or equal to targetScore for early stop to be invoked in {@link Hpo.ExperimentBase}.
However, one might encounter scenarios where floating point arithmetic might render equality check to be imprecise
and early stop is not invoked. In such scenarios, it is recommended to lower the target score by a few decimal points.
Ignored if {@link Hpo.EarlyTermination#checkAutoEarlyStop} is set to False.

title: {@link Hpo.EarlyTermination} allows specification of auto early stopping based on a target conditions.
name: Hpo.EarlyTermination
